# Colossus Shipyards
To assist in developing the Colossus Sector, shuttles from various corporations can be rented for use at Caelestinus Central or Freeport Camelot. Zvezda Orbital Habitation has used vessels of questionable quality available for rental. As a member of the TSFMC, PDV or Caelestinus, you will also have vessels built by your own shipyards available to you through your exclusive shipyard consoles on TSFMC Halcyon, PDV Helios or Caelestinus Central. All rentals last for one shift. Rented shuttles return to the corporate parent company at the end of shift. The value of shuttles is returned to the purchaser when ended through a ship console. To avoid losses, [bold]make sure you end your rental before ending your shift[/bold].
## Shipyard Console
To rent a ship: - Eject the ID card from your PDA. - Insert the ID card into an unused [color=#cccc00]shipyard console[/color]. - Use the shipyard console to bring up its interface. - Select the ship you would like to rent. - Press the Purchase button on the console. - Press the Eject button to remove your ID from the console. - Reinsert your ID card into your PDA.
Congratulations, you're now the Captain of your own ship!
To end your rental: - Make sure your rented ship is docked with wherever you intend to sell it: Caelestinus Central, Zeta Node, Freeport Camelot, Zvezda Orbital Habitation, TSFMC Halcyon and PDV Helios all contain shipyard consoles from which you can sell a ship. - Make sure nobody is aboard the ship. - Eject the ID card [bold]used to purchase the ship[/bold] from your PDA. - Insert the ID card into an unused [color=#cccc00]shipyard console[/color]. - Use the shipyard console to bring up its interface. - Press the Sell button on the console. The value will be deposited into your bank account. - Press the Eject button to remove your ID from the console. - Reinsert your ID card into your PDA.
## Provisions
Ships come equipped with the tools and supplies needed to perform one or more tasks in the Colossus Sector (e.g. mining, research, medical, food services).
Ships, especially larger ones, work best with a crew. Refer to the [bold]Hiring[/bold] section for more info. Space is a lonely, dangerous place, and you'll have a much better time when you work with a crew.
